items.difficulty_reason: 9 行、Galois 扩张的剩余域是 Galois 的：A 整闭 + K = L^G ⇒ A = B^G；one-orbit-geometric 引理给 (1) 剩余域扩张正规、(2) D → Aut 满射；galois 引理给「一个 m 可分 ⇔ 全体可分」；可分时「正规 + Aut 满射」按定义即「Galois + Gal 满射」。承重全在 span 内；2 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-galois-galois (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 33223-33240

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the identification A = B^G from integral closedness and the Galois property of K = L^G, the normality and the surjectivity of the decomposition group onto the automorphism group of the residue extension from the one-orbit-geometric lemma, the invariance of the separable hypothesis across primes from the galois lemma, and the definitional upgrade of normal-plus-surjective to Galois-plus-surjective (source lines 33242-33248)
